'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[2025 Gaza Strip aid distribution killings]]
***[[Israel]]i forces kill at least 57 people in the [[Gaza Strip]], including 35 aid seekers. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/8/2/live-israeli-forces-kill-106-palestinians-in-one-day-of-attacks-on-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***[[Hamas]] releases a sign-of-life [[propaganda]] video showing an emaciated [[Israel]]i hostage, Evyatar David, in an [[Palestinian tunnel warfare in the Gaza Strip|underground tunnel]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/08/02/world/europe/new-hostage-videos-sow-fear-and-horror-in-israel.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-862975 (''Jerusalem Post'')]
**[[Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)|Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]], [[Gaza Strip famine]]
***Seven people die from [[malnutrition]] in the past 24 hours due to the Israeli blockade, according to the [[Gaza Health Ministry]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2x813jm0zo (BBC News)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] launch [[drone warfare|drone attacks]] on [[Penza Oblast]], [[Samara Oblast]], and [[Rostov Oblast]] in [[Russia]], killing at least three people, according to Russian officials. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-drones-trump-witkoff-1626934143a1b25889238a0a62698fe2 (AP)]
***The Ukrainian military targets the [[Ryazan Refinery]] in [[Ryazan Oblast]], Russia, with drones and causes a fire at the facility. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/ukraine-says-it-hit-russian-oil-facilities-military-airfield-2025-08-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 campaign (2022–present)|M23 campaign]]
***[[March 23 Movement|M23 rebels]] briefly capture Kamakombe, [[Kabare Territory]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] from [[Wazalendo]] militia Decisive Movement for the Liberation of Congo. [https://www.radiookapi.net/2025/08/02/actualite/securite/reprise-des-combats-entre-m23-et-wazalendo-au-sud-kivu-malgre-laccord (Radio Okapi)]
***M23 and Wazalendo militias clash in the Muzinzi subgroup, [[Walungu Territory]]. [https://www.radiookapi.net/2025/08/02/actualite/securite/reprise-des-combats-entre-m23-et-wazalendo-au-sud-kivu-malgre-laccord (Radio Okapi)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Five children are killed and 12 others are critically injured in a [[Mortar (weapon)|mortar shell]] explosion in [[Lakki Marwat District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.kuna.net.kw/ArticleDetails.aspx?id=3243148&Language=en (Kuwait News Agency)]
*Mount [[Lewotobi|Lewotobi Laki Laki]], one of [[Indonesia]]'s most active volcanoes, erupts for a second consecutive day, sending a column of volcanic materials and ash up to {{cvt|18|km|mi|abbr=on}} into the sky. Today's eruption is one of Indonesia's largest since 2010 when [[Mount Merapi]] erupted. No casualties are reported. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-mount-lewotobi-laki-laki-volcano-eruption-59657396e52ec5b024ec257c35a79c79 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Seven people are killed and 11 others are injured in a [[prison riot]] at the Social Reintegration Center in [[Tuxpan]], [[Veracruz]], [[Mexico]]. Three inmates identified as key instigators of the violence are transferred to another facility. [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/08/7-inmates-killed-11-injured-in-prison-riot-in-eastern-mexico/ (BNO News)] [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-prison-riot-tuxpan-veracruz-75e046353e3fc41d0616f5ea56b834b0 (AP)]
*A [[Tatmadaw]] court sentences twelve people, including five [[Chinese people|Chinese nationals]], to [[life in prison]] for their involvement in [[human trafficking|trafficking]] [[Burmese people|Burmese]] women to [[forced marriage]]s in [[China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/myanmar-chinese-nationals-life-sentences-15388b68300bcd1303a9ee25d156818c (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*Four-term [[National Assembly (South Korea)|National Assembly]] lawmaker [[Jung Chung-rae]] is elected as the leader of the [[Democratic Party (South Korea, 2015)|Democratic Party]] in [[South Korea]] during the national party convention at [[Korea International Exhibition Center|KINTEX]] in [[Goyang]], [[Gyeonggi Province]], defeating his rival [[Park Chan-dae (politician)|Park Chan-dae]] with 61.74% of the votes. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20250802002300315 (Yonhap News Agency)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 Copa América Femenina]]
**In [[association football]], the [[Brazil women's national football team|Brazil women's team]] wins a record-extending ninth [[Copa América Femenina|Copa América]] title after defeating [[Colombia women's national football team|Colombia]] 5–4 on [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalties]] following a 4–4 draw after [[Overtime (sports)|extra time]] in [[2025 Copa América Femenina final|the final]] held at the [[Estadio Rodrigo Paz Delgado]] in [[Quito]], [[Ecuador]]. Brazilian [[forward (football)|forward]] [[Marta (footballer)|Marta]] is named the [[most valuable player]] of the tournament. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cger7lz31p5o (BBC Sport)]
